svg.title: Supavise architecture (light)
svg.desc: Clients (a browser showing Supabase Studio, the Supabase CLI, the MCP server and your apps) reach one Supavise node over HTTPS. The supavise binary is the HTTPS proxy, the Management API, the project lifecycle engine and the backup service. Each project has its own Postgres, Auth and REST; all projects share Supavisor, Realtime, Storage, Edge Runtime and Studio. Backups go to S3 or local disk, and point-in-time restore runs in place or as a copy. An optional second server joins the node over the mesh port for read replicas and failover. Generated by brand/build.py.
